description: Return the app's normalized design tokens (DTCG: path, type, resolved value, hex / px, alias, CSS var, TS and RN names, description, defining file) for the active token set, plus nameMap (CSS var or TS name → token path). This is the tool that makes a fix use the app's tokens instead of hard-coded literals: look up the token for a colour, spacing, radius or font before writing one. Optional filters: group (first path segment, e.g. color, space), type (color | dimension | fontFamily | …), direction (a named token set instead of the active one). Returns { projectId, set, tokens, nameMap, total }; at most 500 tokens. Read-only. Use get_design_deviance to see where code drifts off these tokens, or get_app_recipe for the overall state.

direction.description: A named token set (directions/<name>/) instead of the active one.

group.description: Only tokens in this group (first path segment, e.g. color, space, radius).

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)

type.description: Only tokens of this DTCG $type (color, dimension, fontFamily, …).

name: get_design_tokens
title: Design tokens
